recognize_zh: 中央一顆顆粒粗大深紫、核被部分遮蓋的嗜鹼性球（basophil），左上的嗜中性球細胞質淡而顆粒稀少（hypogranular），右上為雙葉核的顆粒球，背景血小板增多並有棘狀、橢圓及淚滴形紅血球。
features: Central granulocyte with coarse dark purple granules partly obscuring a bilobed nucleus, consistent with a basophil
Neutrophil (upper left) with pale, hypogranular cytoplasm, a dysplastic feature
Granulocyte with bilobed nucleus (upper right), raising pseudo-Pelger-Huet change versus a second basophil at this resolution
Anisopoikilocytosis with echinocytes, elliptocytes and occasional teardrop cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased platelets and anisopoikilocytosis with echinocytes, elliptocytes and occasional teardrop cells. A basophil with coarse dark granules is present centrally. A neutrophil in the upper left has markedly pale hypogranular cytoplasm, and a bilobed granulocyte in the upper right may represent a pseudo-Pelger-Huet form, although resolution limits separation from a basophil. Findings are consistent with basophilia and dysgranulopoiesis in the setting of myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis.

ddx.vs: CML shows marked leukocytosis with a myelocyte bulge and basophilia but lacks dysplastic hypogranular neutrophils, and is defined by BCR::ABL1.
ET has thrombocytosis without neutrophil dysplasia or ring sideroblasts.
Inherited Pelger-Huet neutrophils have normal granulation and affect nearly all neutrophils without cytopenia or thrombocytosis.
aCML shows leukocytosis with ≥10% circulating immature granulocytes and prominent dysgranulopoiesis, without ring sideroblasts and marked thrombocytosis.
